newsitem.title: USA: CME hog and pork belly futures expected lower.
newsitem.headline: CME hog and pork belly futures expected lower.

text.p: CME hog futures were expected to open 0.100 to 0.500 cent per lb lower while pork bellies were called 0.250 to 0.800 cent lower, livestock analysts said.
Selling is expected in both pits following further weakness in cash hog and pork markets, analysts said.
Cash hog values have eased to lowest levels in four months following the recent setback in cash pork values, they said.
Technicals remain weak with nearbys seen filling chart gaps left after the last Hogs and Pigs report, they added.
